text:
Nina Patel: Quick update — HelixCare approved PO 88221 but their legal returned MSA + DPA with a KMS attestation ask. They're pressing to start the POC tomorrow. Can we spin up seats without a fully executed DPA?
Priya Kapoor: Short answer: possibly. Conditions: customer must sign the Order Form (OF) now, accept a 10-business-day DPA cure period, and acknowledge KMS attestation requires a separate addendum. We'll add explicit language in OF.
Hannah Wu: Finance question — can we invoice on the OF signature alone? Ben?
Ben Torres: We can issue the first invoice against a signed OF + customer PO, but we need a billing caveat: "Initial provisioning and invoice issued subject to DPA execution within 10 business days; failure to execute will pause subsequent provisioning and billing." Add this to OF and flag AR.
Alex Jordan: Operational note — for provisioning we'll only create sandbox-level access until DPA done. No production keys, no persistent egress.
Priya Kapoor: Legal needs Appendix A attached with HelixCare's redlines and the OF must contain a POC-only SLA deviation clause. I can approve the OF once Appendix A is present and the clause includes a 30-day limited SLA (95% uptime) for the POC.
legal-bot: Order Form template v5 validation: required fields: billing_entity, customer_po, term_months, sku_lines, poc_caveat_text, appendix_a_ref. Ensure OF id and Appendix filename included in envelope.
Nina Patel: Customer prefers vendor-sign-first routing. Hannah — can you set DocuSign to vendor-first and CC contracts@redwood.com?
Hannah Wu: Yes — I can build envelope vendor-first. Routing: contracts@redwood.com (signer 1) -> legal@helixcare.com (signer 2) -> sales@helixcare.com (final). Attaching HelixCare_redlines_v2.pdf.
HelixCare (via Alex): HelixCare here — we can accept vendor-first. KMS attestation timeline: 7-8 business days. Exec contact is ops@helixcare.com.
Priya Kapoor: Approving the limited POC SLA as described. Note: no KMS/HSM commitments in OF; any attestation must be through KMS Addendum (separate doc). Exec waiver required for any deviation beyond 30 days.
Ben Torres: Recorded for billing: PO 88221, initial invoice ready once envelope completes. If DPA not executed within 10 business days, we'll halt invoices beyond the initial one and suspend provisioning.
Hannah Wu: Envelope created at 3152467917 — DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/helix-88221. Routing set to vendor-first, Appendix A attached. :white_check_mark:
Nina Patel: Thanks everyone. Summary for tracker: PO 88221, envelope helix-88221, vendor-first OF, sandbox provisioning permitted pending DPA within 10 business days, limited SLA approved. I'll watch for DPA return by 2026-04-20 and ping legal if overdue.
Priya Kapoor: I'll sign once Appendix A is verified. Leave a note in the envelope about the KMS Addendum path.
Alex Jordan: We'll provision sandbox seats tomorrow morning and tag them "POC-sandbox-helix".
HelixCare (via Alex): We'll upload DPA redlines into the envelope within 24 hours. Thanks team. :pray:
